Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy
public static final class ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable fail-closed bisection receipt for one continuous sampled feasibility transition.

The result is a bracket between independently evaluated feasible and infeasible action values. It is diagnostic evidence, not an interpolated set point or accepted operating point.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team

  • Constructor Details

    • OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement

      private OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement(ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionTransition transition, double actionLowerBound, double actionUpperBound, double relativeTolerance, double absoluteTolerance, String toleranceProvenance, int maximumEvaluations, double feasibleAxisValue, double infeasibleAxisValue, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence feasibleBoundaryConstraint, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence infeasibleBoundaryConstraint, List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence> feasibleBoundaryConstraintEvidence, List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.LeadingConstraintEvidence> infeasibleBoundaryConstraintEvidence, ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement.Status status, List<ProcessModelOperatingEnvelopeStudy.OperatingRegionBoundaryRefinement.Step> steps)
      Creates one immutable refinement receipt.
      Parameters:
      transition - sampled transition being refined
      actionLowerBound - configured action lower bound
      actionUpperBound - configured action upper bound
      relativeTolerance - terminal tolerance relative to action range
      absoluteTolerance - terminal tolerance in action units
      toleranceProvenance - engineering source of the tolerance
      maximumEvaluations - configured midpoint budget
      feasibleAxisValue - final independently evaluated feasible value
      infeasibleAxisValue - final independently evaluated infeasible value
      feasibleBoundaryConstraint - leading constraint at the final feasible endpoint
      infeasibleBoundaryConstraint - rejecting constraint at the final infeasible endpoint
      feasibleBoundaryConstraintEvidence - complete normalized evidence at the final feasible endpoint
      infeasibleBoundaryConstraintEvidence - complete exact rejecting evidence at the final infeasible endpoint
      status - terminal refinement status
      steps - complete midpoint evidence
